title: Disable Apotheosis Minibosses
description: Disables the default mini-boss spawns from Apotheosis (e.g. Honeyed Archer, Undead Knight)
body: Disables the various mini-bosses from Apotheosis from spawning and cluttering up your world. Examples include the "Honeyed Archer" and the "Undead Knight". This does **not** effect boss spawns (i.e. the ones that send a notification on-screen and drop affixed items equipment).
